newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT- Petron rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT- Petron rated a buy.

text.p: Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp was rated a buy on Friday by brokerage firm Sun Hung Kai Securities (Phil) Inc on news that it had signed a memorandum of understanding with Ssangyong Oil Refining Co Ltd to study the possibility of building a grassroots oil refinery.

"The new refinery will impact on Petron's earnings in the long term. We continue to recommend a buy on the company since we think it will still be a winner even after full deregulation in 1997," said Raul Ruiz, vice-president at Sun Hung Kai.
Ruiz added that with Saudi Aramco as a 40 percent shareholder, Petron will be provided with certain advantages in terms of supply and technical expertise.
"Petron is an efficient producer and we think that even with the entry of more players, the company will be able to compete in terms of pricing," said Ruiz.

Pending claims of Petron from the government's Oil Price Stabilisation Fund (OPSF) amounting to over one billion pesos may be settled soon, Ruiz added. "It will eventually be reimbursed and will not be an issue against the company," he said.
